name: Flipsnack
description_en:
Flipsnack turns PDFs and other supported files into online flipbooks and provides a Design Studio for page content and interactive elements. The workflow combines document conversion, a configurable reader, publishing visibility and plan-dependent analytics, branding and downloads. Its Edit PDF Beta can make vector text/shapes/images editable, subject to conversion limits.

It fits teams publishing catalogs, brochures, reports or internal documents with a link or embed. A hosted flipbook, a downloadable PDF and an HTML5 package are different deliverables. Plan for page/file limits, reader privacy, rendering checks and recurring subscription conditions rather than assuming that uploading a PDF makes every interaction or private-sharing method available.
description_zh:
Flipsnack 把 PDF 等受支持文件转成在线翻页刊物，并通过 Design Studio 编辑页面内容和交互元素。流程包括文档转换、阅读器配置、可见性发布，以及按套餐提供的分析、品牌和下载。Edit PDF Beta 可把矢量文字/形状/图像变成可编辑元素，但有转换限制。

它适合以链接或嵌入发布目录、宣传册、报告及内部文档的团队。托管翻页刊物、下载 PDF 和 HTML5 包是不同交付物。需要考虑页数/文件限制、读者隐私、渲染检查和循环订阅，不能假定上传 PDF 就拥有全部交互或私密分享方式。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload supported files, customize player branding/controls, add optional interactions and publish with chosen visibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传受支持文件、配置阅读器品牌/控件、添加可选交互并按可见性发布。

core_features.explanation_en: Convert a vector PDF/PPTX/ODP into editable layers, or make an editable copy/single page. Fonts and effects have constraints.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把矢量PDF/PPTX/ODP转为可编辑图层，或创建可编辑副本/单页；字体及效果受限。

core_features.explanation_en: Private access, analytics, branding, HTML5 download, seats and AI credits depend on the plan/workspace.
core_features.explanation_zh: 私密访问、分析、品牌、HTML5下载、席位及AI点数按套餐/工作区不同。

sections.title_en: A published document experience rather than a plain file transfer
sections.title_zh: 发布文档体验而非单纯传文件
sections.en:
Flipsnack’s [conversion guide](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/1316657-converting-a-pdf-file-into-a-flipbook) separates the reader/player from the Design Studio. The reader controls branding, appearance, navigation and optional add-ons; the studio adds page interactions such as links, video and music. A PDF can be published without extra interactions. Analytics, lead forms, shopping lists and catalog automation belong to specific plans, not to every converted file.

Editorial example: turn an approved product catalog into a browser publication, add product links and share the current edition. This can simplify distribution but does not establish a transactional ecommerce backend or automatic inventory/PIM synchronization. Keep the approved source document and verify any optional integration separately.
sections.zh:
Flipsnack 的[转换指南](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/1316657-converting-a-pdf-file-into-a-flipbook)区分阅读器与 Design Studio。阅读器配置品牌、外观、导航及可选附加项；Studio 添加链接、视频及音乐等页面交互。PDF 无额外交互也能发布。分析、线索表单、购物清单及目录自动化属于特定方案，并非每个转换文件都有。

编辑示例：把获批产品目录转成浏览器刊物，加入产品链接并分享当前版。这可以帮助分发，但不证明有交易型电商后端或自动库存/PIM 同步。应保留批准的源文档，另行验证可选集成。

sections.title_en: Upload, customize, inspect and publish deliberately
sections.title_zh: 上传、配置、检查并明确发布
sections.en:
Click Create → Upload files, then choose a device file, a connected Google Drive file or the Beta editing route. Multiple PDFs can be merged, but the combined page count still must fit the plan. A normal upload converts automatically and opens Customize with Branding, Appearance, Controls and Add-ons panels. Their “Save options for future flipbooks” toggles set defaults for later uploads; avoid unintentionally carrying a campaign’s tracking or branding settings into unrelated work. Open Edit to add page-level interactions.

Click Share and choose Public, Unlisted or an eligible Private method, then Publish/Update. Public content can be indexed; Unlisted is link-accessible and should not be treated as authentication. Private methods and scheduled publishing are plan-scoped. Inspect the published reader, mobile navigation, links and access using the intended reader identity. A successful upload or editor preview is not equivalent to correct live access or working analytics.
sections.zh:
点击 Create → Upload files，选择本机文件、已连接 Google Drive 文件或 Beta 编辑路线。多个 PDF 可合并，但合计页数仍须符合套餐。普通上传自动转换后进入 Customize，包含 Branding、Appearance、Controls 和 Add-ons；“Save options for future flipbooks”会设为后续上传默认值，应避免把某活动的追踪或品牌配置无意带到其他工作。点 Edit 添加页面交互。

点击 Share，选择 Public、Unlisted 或套餐允许的 Private 方式，再 Publish/Update。Public 可被索引；Unlisted 持链接可访问，不能当作认证。私密方式及定时发布按套餐限制。应以目标读者身份检查线上阅读器、移动导航、链接和访问。上传成功或编辑器预览不等于真实访问正确或分析已工作。

sections.title_en: Editable conversion depends on the source PDF
sections.title_zh: 可编辑转换取决于源 PDF
sections.en:
The [Edit PDF guide](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/how-to-edit-a-pdf-in-flipsnack) describes full-document conversion, an editable copy of an existing uploaded publication, or conversion of one page with an option to revert. It supports vector PDF, PPTX and ODP. The document says all plans are eligible, while its subtitle still calls the feature Beta by request; confirm actual account availability. An editable copy preserves the original rather than overwriting it.

Keep live, straight text and embed fonts. Subset or unavailable fonts can preserve the original appearance while failing to support newly typed characters; the editor offers matching/replacing a missing font or uploading the original under Branding → Fonts. Avoid text on curves, text effects, gradients, clipping masks and highly complex vectors. The Beta guide warns of broken effects, loading problems or shifting elements when zooming, recommends single pages instead of spreads, and says imported PDFs cannot be saved as templates during Beta. Rasterizing an effect may improve appearance but removes editability. Validate a representative document before promising a lossless client conversion.
sections.zh:
[Edit PDF 指南](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/how-to-edit-a-pdf-in-flipsnack)描述整本转换、为已有上传刊物创建可编辑副本，或只转一页并可恢复。支持矢量 PDF、PPTX 和 ODP。正文表示全部方案可用，副标题仍称 Beta 需申请，应确认实际账户权限。可编辑副本保留原刊物，不直接覆盖。

应保留未转曲的直排文字并嵌入字体。子集字体或缺失字体可能保持原外观，却无法正常输入新字符；编辑器提供匹配/替换缺失字体，或在 Branding → Fonts 上传原字体。避免曲线文字、文字效果、渐变、裁切蒙版及复杂矢量。Beta 指南警告效果损坏、加载问题或缩放时元素移位，建议单页而非跨页，并表示 Beta 期间导入 PDF 不能存为模板。把效果栅格化可能改善外观，却失去可编辑性。承诺无损转换前应验证代表文档。

sections.title_en: The actual plan controls pages, files and private features
sections.title_zh: 实际套餐控制页数、文件及私密功能
sections.en:
The read [plan guide](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/107456-pricing-plans-explained) and [limit article](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/1994890-file-size-and-page-limit) agree on Free 5 flipbooks, 15 pages each and 100 MB uploads; Starter 5 books, 100 pages/100 MB; Pro 50 books, 200 pages/500 MB; Business 100 books, 500 pages/500 MB. Enterprise page limits are contract-specific; the generic limit article lists up to 3,000 pages/500 MB. Each flipbook accepts at most 100 uploaded files. Split or upgrade an oversized publication rather than assuming merging removes limits.

Free is indefinite with watermarked downloads and one-time 250 AI credits, but lacks private/password sharing, analytics and monthly AI credits. Starter includes one user and 100 monthly AI credits but embeds remain branded. Pro adds analytics, password protection, richer interactions, unbranded embeds and 250 monthly AI credits. Business adds branding, scheduled publication, specific-reader sharing, HTML5 download, Zapier and 500 monthly credits. These are vendor-documented allowances, not tested output or security guarantees.
sections.zh:
实读[套餐指南](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/107456-pricing-plans-explained)及[限制文章](https://help.flipsnack.com/en/articles/1994890-file-size-and-page-limit)一致列出：Free 为5本、每本15页及100 MB上传；Starter为5本、100页/100 MB；Pro为50本、200页/500 MB；Business为100本、500页/500 MB。Enterprise页数按合同，通用限制文章列最多3,000页/500 MB。每本最多100个上传文件，超限应拆分或升级，合并不取消限制。

Free长期有效，下载带水印、一次性250 AI点，但无私密/密码分享、分析及月度AI额度。Starter含1用户、每月100 AI点，嵌入仍带品牌；Pro增加分析、密码保护、更多交互、无品牌嵌入及每月250 AI点；Business增加品牌、定时发布、指定读者、HTML5下载、Zapier及每月500点。这些是厂商文档额度，不是输出或安全实测保证。

sections.title_en: Workspace subscriptions, seats and renewal conditions
sections.title_zh: 工作区订阅、席位及续费条件
sections.en:
USD pricing in the read guide: Starter $35 monthly or $192 yearly ($16/month equivalent); Pro $52 or $456 yearly ($38 equivalent); Business $109 or $1,020 yearly ($85 equivalent). Business includes one user and can add four, to five total, at $25/extra user/month with annual billing or $32 monthly. Enterprise is custom, with some integrations, reader/workspace management and success services charged separately. Workspaces can have different plans; the retired Team plan and old Professional name should not be treated as current offers.

The current guide says general access starts with an indefinite Free plan rather than a standard time-limited trial, while discussing separately arranged Enterprise evaluation. No one-time AI credit packs are sold according to its FAQ. Auto-renew must be canceled at least 48 hours before the period ends. Terms generally exclude refunds, with discretionary review windows of seven days for monthly and fourteen for annual plans, not a guaranteed money-back promise. Interrupted legacy plans cannot be reactivated under the guide.
sections.zh:
实读指南美元报价：Starter月付$35或年付$192（折合每月$16），Pro为$52或年付$456（折合$38），Business为$109或年付$1,020（折合$85）。Business含1用户，可加4位至总计5位，额外用户年付每月$25、月付$32。Enterprise询价，部分集成、读者/工作区管理和成功服务另收费。各工作区可用不同方案，已停售Team及旧Professional名称不能当当前报价。

指南表示普通访问从长期Free开始，并非标准限时试用，另有商定的Enterprise评估。FAQ表示不卖一次性AI点数包。自动续费须在账期结束至少48小时前取消。条款原则不退款，月付7天、年付14天内可申请酌情审查，并非保证退款。指南还表示中断的旧套餐不可重新启用。

sections.title_en: Content ownership does not remove hosted-service dependencies
sections.title_zh: 内容所有权不取消托管依赖
sections.en:
The [terms](https://legal.flipsnack.com/terms-of-service) retain users’ content ownership and grant the provider a limited operational license, while reserving the platform software/source rights. User-supplied fonts, images and personal information still require appropriate permission. Published documents depend on service access and plan traffic limits: the terms allow reducing availability after the assigned threshold is exceeded. “Unlimited flipbooks” is therefore not unlimited service consumption.

Keep source files and an eligible export before changing service; an HTML5 download is not itself an open-source license or proof of identical hosted functionality. Exact traffic quotas, cancellation impact on existing reader links, export accessibility and integration behavior were not verified. No upload, Beta conversion, publishing, purchase or permission test was executed.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://legal.flipsnack.com/terms-of-service)保留用户内容所有权，并给厂商有限运营许可，同时保留平台软件/源码权利。用户字体、图像及个人信息仍需适当权限。已发布刊物依赖服务及套餐流量限制，条款允许超出额度后降低可用性，因此“无限刊物”不等于无限消耗服务。

改变服务前应保留源文件及可用导出；HTML5下载本身不是开源许可，也不证明与托管功能完全一致。具体流量额度、取消对已有读者链接的影响、导出可访问性及集成行为未验证。未执行上传、Beta转换、发布、购买或权限测试。
